messages.author: 5c527e0ee4045a32
messages.subject: Plot visuals
parts:
Hello,
I am just wondering if anyone knows how I can adjust the visuals on the UD plots (make the points smaller and filled for example so you can see all the home ranges) because the usual pch and cex arguments don't work. Also not sure why the legend is so oddly spaced. 
Thank you,
Devin

messages.author: 5c527e0ee4045a32
messages.subject: Re: Plot visuals
parts:
Please disregard, I figured out here https://rdrr.io/cran/ctmm/man/plot.telemetry.html that error needed to = FALSE.
Fixed legend with y.intersp as well.
Thank you,
Devin

messages.subject: Re: Plot visuals
parts:
Hi Devin,

Alternatively, if you wanted to keep the scale of location error and fill in the error circles, you can use error=2 and then adjust the transparency until it looks good.

Best,
Chris
